title: Wi-Fi client password guards execute text and continue destructive changes
description:
Invalid password guards invoke a quoted message as a command instead of __ALERT. Exact isolated-function stubs show password x writes configuration/disables or deletes the old connection and returns OK despite command-not-found. Reject invalid length before mutations and test lower/upper bounds plus valid controls. No network/service/reboot was executed. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.

Imported from .factory/findings/active/FND-20261101215425-fa40-complete-full-repository-audit-003.json (category: functional, blocking: no).

outcome.summary: Script fix is correct and minimal: tools/rpi_ctrl.sh:449-450 and tools/rpi_ctrl_v2.sh:450-451 now call __ALERT (echo + exit 1) before any backup/write/nmcli step, matching the neighbouring guards. The test reproduces the defect: on the old lines the bare string is executed as a command (status 127) and the scripts continue, so the length 7/64 assertions on stdout, empty call log and unchanged config fail; on the new tree make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client passes (3 tests, GNU sed 4.9). Sandbox safety checked: every *_EXE comes from 'which' on a PATH of stubs plus symlinked grep/head/tr/which; sleep/systemctl/reboot/nmcli/raspi-config are stubs; all CONF_*/PROC_FORWARD assignments are rewritten (exactly-one-match check plus a /etc|/proc guard); *.orig files are pre-created so __create_reset_files copies nothing; the scripts have no absolute-path command calls on these paths. Wiring OK: test-unit depends on the new phony target (indigo_test/Makefile:377-382), the AGENTS.md list documents it, and the pbxproj adds the file to the indigo_test/unit group with a unique ID. Header matches indigo_test/AGENTS.md. git diff --check clean. DEFECT (must fix): the rpi_ctrl.sh positive control is not portable to macOS, where indigo_test (and so test-unit/test) is supported (Makefile has Darwin branches). The dhcpcd fixture (test_rpi_ctrl_wifi_client.py:62) contains the hotspot lines, so the accepted-password path runs the host's real sed via LOGGED_REAL (line 51) as 'sed -i "s/...//" file' (tools/rpi_ctrl.sh:472/475/478). BSD sed takes the expression as the -i backup suffix and the file path as the script, fails, and the script prints 'ALERT: cannot remove ...', so the subtests at lines 170-179 (rpi_ctrl.sh, lengths 8 and 63) fail and make -C indigo_test test-unit breaks on macOS [verify: not run on macOS; based on documented BSD sed -i semantics]. Suggested fix: keep sed out of the accepted path for this control, for example use a dhcpcd fixture without the three hotspo

Round 2: both findings resolved. The dhcpcd fixture (indigo_test/unit/test_rpi_ctrl_wifi_client.py:62-64) no longer has the access point lines, so the grep -Eq at tools/rpi_ctrl.sh:471 does not match and the GNU-only sed -i edits (472/475/478) are skipped; no other sed call is on the tested path, so the accepted-password runs are portable to BSD sed. The control still proves lengths 8 and 63 pass the guard: stdout OK, psk written to wpa_supplicant.conf, systemctl disable hostapd and reboot logged (v1); nmcli dev wifi connect with the password, exit 0 (v2). The rejection cases are unchanged and still fail on the unfixed scripts (the old code runs the logged cp backups and rewrites wpa_supplicant.conf / issues nmcli calls before reaching OK). indigo_test/AGENTS.md:65 now lists the PATH contents accurately. Script fix, sandbox safety, Makefile and Xcode wiring unchanged from round 1 and still correct. make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client: 3 tests OK on this tree; git diff --check master...HEAD clean. Not run on macOS. The unit check's libindigo build failure is the known environment limitation, not a finding.

Combined tree review (master...HEAD incl. merged sub-ticket 656ea713, b68c90a16). rpi_ctrl.sh:449-450 and rpi_ctrl_v2.sh:452-453 now use __ALERT so lengths 7/64 exit before any mutation; v2 empty password skips the length checks and joins with 'nmcli dev wifi connect SSID' (rpi_ctrl_v2.sh:450-463). v2 channel readback (317), psk-only-required-with-key-mgmt readback (376, 491), indigo3 install via apt-cache show (555-557) and unknown-argument ${1} (669) are correct. Test files agree with the final v2 script: test_rpi_ctrl_wifi_client.py checks v2 7/64 rejected and 8/63 accepted, which the open-network change preserves; test_rpi_ctrl_v2.py adds the empty-password open join and repeats 1/7/64 and 8/63. Makefile wires both PHONY targets into test-unit (indigo_test/Makefile:377-387); test target reaches them once via test-unit. Xcode: both PBXFileReference IDs unique, listed once in the unit group (path = unit). AGENTS.md lines match both modules. Safety: bash by absolute path, PATH = stubs + symlinked grep/head/tr/which (+ logging wrappers of real cat/cp/sed in the v1 test only, on redirected files); both sandboxes refuse a copy that still names /etc or /proc; scripts contain no hard-coded absolute command paths (only a read of /sys/class/net/eth0/carrier in reset paths not exercised). Ran make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client (3 OK) and test-rpi-ctrl-v2 (10 OK, no skips on this host with GNU grep). Non-blocking notes: v2 password-length cases are duplicated across the two test files; v1 still rejects an empty client password while v2 accepts it (intentional, v2-only scope); the PCRE-dependent v2 cases skip on BSD grep (documented).

history.text: Writing stubbed regression test for rpi_ctrl Wi-Fi client password guards
Running new test against unfixed scripts (reproduction)

Reproduction (before fix): new indigo_test/unit/test_rpi_ctrl_wifi_client.py runs each script copy with config paths redirected to a temp dir and PATH limited to argv-logging stubs plus which/grep/head/tr (non-root, no host network/service command reachable). Password length 7 and 64: both scripts print 'OK' instead of 'ALERT: WIFI_CN_PW length < 8/> 63', stderr shows 'WIFI_CN_PW length < 8: command not found' (rpi_ctrl.sh:449-450, rpi_ctrl_v2.sh:450-451). Length 7 call logs: v1 cp wpa_supplicant/dhcpcd backups, cat > wpa_supplicant.conf, 3x sed -i dhcpcd.conf, systemctl disable hostapd, reboot (exit 1 from last option test); v2 nmcli con down/delete indigo-wifi, dev wifi connect, con modify, con up, exit 0. Result: 4 failing subtests (both scripts x 7/64); controls 8/63 pass.
Check command-1 started: make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client

After fix (both scripts use __ALERT for the WIFI_CN_PW length checks): same test passes, 3 tests / 6 subtests OK. Lengths 7 and 64 print 'ALERT: WIFI_CN_PW length < 8' / '> 63', exit 1, empty stub call log, config files unchanged, no 'command not found'; lengths 8 and 63 still proceed (v1 writes psk, systemctl disable hostapd, reboot; v2 nmcli dev wifi connect, exit 0). flow check --command 'make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client' passed on tree e0ddb360. Plain flow check: whitespace passed; unit FAILED for an environment reason unrelated to the change: this host lacks libusb-1.0 and avahi-client development files (ld: cannot find -lusb-1.0; avahi-client/client.h missing; libjpeg/libtiff/hidapi configure 'C compiler cannot create executables' for the same -lusb-1.0 link), so libindigo does not build and test-unit cannot start. Installing packages needs root and was not done.
Reviewing diff of Wi-Fi password guards and new unit test
Running narrow test: make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client
Implementation resumed: the review requested changes
Review fixes: BSD-sed-safe dhcpcd fixture, AGENTS.md wording; rerunning test
Check command-1 started: make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client

Review round 1 fixes: dhcpcd fixture no longer contains the access point lines, so the rpi_ctrl.sh accepted-password control skips the GNU-only 'sed -i EXPR FILE' (macOS/BSD sed portability). v1 control call log is now cp, cp, cat, sleep, systemctl, sleep, reboot. AGENTS.md wording now matches the module docstring. Re-verified: against master's unfixed scripts the test still fails 4 subtests (7/64 x both scripts); against the fixed scripts 3 tests pass. flow check --command 'make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client' and --check whitespace passed on tree 86d41dd2. Full unit check still blocked by missing libusb-1.0/avahi-client dev packages on this host.
Round 2 re-review: fixture and AGENTS.md changes
Running narrow test: make -C indigo_test test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client
Reviewing combined diff master...HEAD after sub-ticket 656ea713 merge
Running make test-rpi-ctrl-wifi-client and test-rpi-ctrl-v2 in the workspace
